clue.text: Minor drawback

indicators.note: the second half of the word signals that draw is written backwards

parts.note: the first part of the word drawback, draw, taken as written; its turned letters sitting in the clue are no coincidence of hiding but the split of the word itself

explanation.surface: A small disadvantage, nothing serious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawback' looks like a snag; split it into 'draw' and 'back' and it tells you to turn DRAW round.
explanation.definitionFit: A ward is a child or young person under the legal protection of a guardian, i.e. someone under age.

clue.text: Take care! The time is not right

parts.note: a timepiece on the wrist is a watch, the thing that gives the time
a reckoning that is out is inaccurate, not right

explanation.surface: A warning shouted because the moment is wrong for acting.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay reads as a watch that is out, i.e. showing the wrong time.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation urging caution, said when danger is near.

clue.text: Girl's hair was causing great unhappiness

parts.note: Di, short for Diana, is a girl's name; with the possessive it gives DI'S
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A young woman's hairstyle was making her miserable.
explanation.definitionFit: Distress is acute anguish or suffering, a deep misery.

clue.text: Unhappy writer, manipulated by his editor perhaps

parts.note: feeling blue means feeling sad
a pencil is a writing implement

explanation.surface: A miserable author whose work is pushed around by his editor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writer' suggests an author, but it is the tool he writes with.
explanation.definitionFit: Editors traditionally marked cuts and corrections in blue crayon, so the implement is wielded by them.

clue.text: He looks after the workers

parts.note: the workers are not factory hands but the worker bees of a hive

explanation.surface: A foreman or union steward caring for staff.
explanation.definitionFit: An apiarist tends hives of bees, most of which are sterile female workers.

clue.text: Not at all well when taken out of doors

explanation.surface: Someone falls ill after being carried outside.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is literal: anything outdoors is exposed beneath the sky's conditions.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means feeling ill; literally, out of doors one stands beneath the rain or sun.

clue.text: Removal is certain after a time

indicators.note: after places the word for certain behind the word for a time

parts.note: an era is a period or age of time
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A removal is guaranteed once some time has passed.
explanation.definitionFit: Erasing something wipes it out, so the act of rubbing out is a kind of removal.

clue.text: Instruments sused to destroy bird cages

parts.note: a crow is a black bird
cages are made of bars

explanation.surface: Tools for smashing up birdcages.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron levers used for prising apart and wrecking things, such as forcing doors open.

clue.text: A kind of early bird

parts.note: not a person who rises early but a hen that produces eggs, often first thing in the morning

explanation.surface: A type of person who gets up at dawn.
explanation.definitionFit: A hen kept for egg production is named for laying eggs, typically in the morning.

clue.text: The first children formed a network

indicators.note: first takes only the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: issue means offspring, a person's children

explanation.surface: The earliest children joined together into a web.
explanation.definitionFit: Biological tissue is an interwoven mesh of cells; fine fabric is also a woven web.

clue.text: Cover up for a member of parliament who is late

indicators.note: up turns the word for cover backwards, written right to left

parts.note: a lid is a cover
a Tory is a Conservative member of parliament

explanation.surface: An MP is covered for, being behind time.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilatory means slow or tardy, given to delay.

clue.text: Listens to the last coffin bearer

parts.note: hears means listens

indicators.note: last takes only the final letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: Someone pays attention to the last pallbearer at a funeral.
explanation.definitionFit: A funeral vehicle carries the coffin to the grave.

clue.text: Recount details about the anaesthetic

parts.note: re means about, concerning
something that numbs is a number, an anaesthetic

explanation.surface: Describing particulars of an anaesthetic.
explanation.walkthrough: NUMBER here is 'numb-er', a thing that numbs, not the noun for a figure.
explanation.definitionFit: To count again is to assign the figures afresh.

clue.text: Perhaps I might be given a jewel

indicators.note: the letters might be given a new order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone hopes they may be presented with a gem.
explanation.definitionFit: A precious blue gemstone, a variety of corundum.

clue.text: Ditch, and come down in part of Germany

parts.note: a rhine is a dialect word for a drainage ditch, used in the Somerset Levels
to land is to come down to earth

explanation.surface: Abandon something and alight in a German region.
explanation.definitionFit: The region along the river in western Germany is known by that name.

clue.text: Work done in a back street is the best

indicators.note: in puts the work inside the street abbreviation
back turns the abbreviation for street around

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A job carried out in a rear alley is the finest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back street' reads as an alley, but 'back' is the reversal signal for the street abbreviation; 'done' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is the tops is the finest, first-rate.

clue.text: Fruit is put in nextreme edges of bedroom, but still can lead to poisoning

parts.note: a plum is a fruit

indicators.note: put in places the word is inside the outer letters
the extreme edges are the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: Fruit placed at the ends of a bedroom might still poison someone.
explanation.walkthrough: The first and last letters of 'bedroom' are B and M; IS goes between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumbism is the medical term for chronic toxicity from the metal Pb.

clue.text: Like to get first class return to the continent

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: return turns the first-class letters back to front

parts.note: A1 means first-class, with the 1 written as I

explanation.surface: Someone travels first class on a return trip to another continent.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 is read as AI; 'return' makes it IA.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest of the world's landmasses.

clue.text: He doesn't believe in coasting out of gear

indicators.note: a gearbox out of gear is disordered, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A driver who refuses to freewheel in neutral.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds that God's existence cannot be known, so withholds belief.

clue.text: It's OK, there's nothing left!

explanation.surface: Reassurance that all is fine since none is remaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Means satisfactory; and nothing on the left means everything is on the right side.

clue.text: Second rate, undercooked fish caused fighting

parts.note: B is the second-rate grade, below A
raw means undercooked
ling is a sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A poorly cooked fish dish started a punch-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A brawl is a rough noisy fight, so this is scrapping.

clue.text: Big noise made about reactionary who only caused tired annoyance

indicators.note: made about puts the noise around the political word

parts.note: a boom is a big noise
the setter uses this loosely for a Red, a political extremist

explanation.surface: A loud blast around a political extremist caused only weary irritation.
explanation.definitionFit: Weariness and irritation from dullness or lack of interest.

clue.text: Something sweet made with rare recipe

indicators.note: a recipe mixes ingredients, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A dessert prepared with an unusual recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A light brown cane sugar named after a region of Guyana.

clue.text: Right code to break to discover the colour scheme

indicators.note: breaking the code scrambles its letters

explanation.surface: Cracking the right code reveals a design plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to break' scrambles CODE into DECO; R for right goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: The interior decoration of a room, including its furnishing and paint shades.

clue.text: One who produces a response which is always alright inside

indicators.note: inside puts the word for alright within the word for always

parts.note: ever means always
OK means alright

explanation.surface: A person whose answers are constantly fine.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke is to call forth a feeling or reaction, so one who does so elicits it.

clue.text: Just like a youngster to be rather stupid!

explanation.surface: Behaving like a kid seems foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: Means typical of a young person, and also silly or immature in an adult.

clue.text: Performing part of a play in middle age

parts.note: an act is a division of a play

indicators.note: middle takes the central letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: Playing a role in a show during middle age.
explanation.definitionFit: Performing on stage is playing a role.

clue.text: Recalled MP in a rush

indicators.note: in puts the MP word inside the plant

parts.note: a reed is a rush, a marsh plant
MP stands for Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An MP was summoned back hurriedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rush' looks like haste but is the waterside plant.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring back to mind; to call up from memory.

clue.text: Found on stage?

explanation.surface: Discovered appearing in a theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: To found metal is to shape it in a mould; the actors in a show are its company.
